an3.81:1.1: Tīṇ' imāni bhikkhave samaṇassa samaṇakaraṇīyāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Adhisīla-sikkhā-samādānaṃ, adhicitta-sikkhā-samādānaṃ, adhipaññā-sikkhā-samādānaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇakaraṇīyāni.
an3.81:2.1: Tasmāt iha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne ti. Evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabban ti.
